title_en: Russian strikes wound nine and damage Ukraine's power network ahead of talks
title_zh: 会谈前俄罗斯发动袭击造成九人受伤并破坏乌克兰电力网络
summary: The attacks come before Ukrainian and Russian delegations are due to take part in trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi next week.
summary_zh: 这些袭击发生在乌克兰和俄罗斯代表团下周参加阿布扎比三边会谈之前。
body_en: By Olivia Ireland and Dan Johnson , Reporting from in Kyiv
Overnight drone and ballistic missile attacks damaged Ukrainian energy infrastructure, President Volodymyr Zelenskyhas said, causing blackouts and disrupting water supplies.
Zelensky said 12 Ukrainian regions came under attack with the capital Kyiv hit hardest.
Nine people are reported to have been hurt across the country, including one child, in the wave of attacks that consisted of more than 30 ballistic missiles and over 170 drones.
The attacks come before Ukrainian and Russian delegations are due to take part in trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi next week.
Zelensky wrote on Telegram , external that Moscow was preparing for the talks by launching attacks on Ukraine's "critical infrastructure".
Temperatures are dropping in Ukraine, and parts of the country have had the first winter snow.

"The situation in the capital is difficult, with disruptions to electricity, water, and heating supplies. Residential buildings, the North Bridge, and a kindergarten have been damaged," Zelensky said.
"In the Kyiv region, there were strikes on substations that connect the Rivne and Khmelnytsky nuclear power plants to Kyiv and central Ukraine."

In his latest update, Kyiv's Mayor Vitali Klitschko said the city's water supply system is back to operating normally. He also said around 60% of the city's apartment buildings were connected to the heating system.
The energy minister, Denys Shmyhal, said there were power cuts in five regions but did not say how many homes were affected.
Zelensky added that beyond Kyiv, substations were damaged in Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Kharkiv and Dnipro regions.
The latest attacks come after US First Lady Melania Trump hosted Russian and Ukrainian delegations at the White House on Thursday.
She called for a "more enduring" ceasefire in Ukraine following a truce last week in the southern region of Kherson.

She thanked both Zelensky and Russian President Vladimir Putin, making no reference to the origins of the war, which began when Putin launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, which has caused thousands of civilian casualties and the displacement of millions.

Hundreds of residents of the Russian-occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky facing starvation and constant bombardment were able to evacuate during a six-day ceasefire , which both Moscow and Kyiv credited Trump with brokering.
"The lives of innocent people must transcend the division of war. I hope Oleshky inspires greater peace," she said.
Earlier this week, a number of people were killed when glide bombs hit an aid centre near Zaporizhzhia , with the death toll rising to 55 as teams search deeper into the ruins.
Zelensky added in his Telegram post on Saturday following the latest attacks that Ukraine was counting on increased bilateral support from the United States.
He wrote: "We are counting on unity between both parties on issues of security, support for Ukraine, condemnation of Russian aggression, and increased sanctions pressure on Putin.
body_zh: 奥利维亚·爱尔兰和丹·约翰逊，基辅报道
总统泽连斯基表示，夜间无人机和弹道导弹袭击破坏了乌克兰能源基础设施，导致停电和供水中断。
泽连斯基表示，乌克兰12个地区遭受袭击，其中首都基辅受灾最严重。
据报道，在这波由 30 多枚弹道导弹和 170 多架无人机组成的袭击浪潮中，全国有 9 人受伤，其中包括一名儿童。
这些袭击发生在乌克兰和俄罗斯代表团下周参加阿布扎比三边会谈之前。
泽伦斯基在 Telegram 上撰文称，莫斯科正在通过对乌克兰的“关键基础设施”发动攻击来为会谈做准备。
乌克兰气温正在下降，该国部分地区迎来了冬季的第一场雪。
“首都的情况很困难，电力、水和供暖供应中断。住宅楼、北桥和一所幼儿园遭到破坏，”泽伦斯基说。
“在基辅地区，连接罗夫诺和赫梅利尼茨基核电站与基辅和乌克兰中部的变电站发生了罢工。”
基辅市长维塔利·克里琴科在最新更新中表示，该市的供水系统已恢复正常运行。他还表示，该市约 60% 的公寓楼都连接了供暖系统。
能源部长丹尼斯·什米哈尔表示，五个地区停电，但没有透露有多少家庭受到影响。
泽伦斯基补充说，在基辅以外，文尼察、日托米尔、里夫内、哈尔科夫和第聂伯罗地区的变电站遭到破坏。
最近的袭击发生在美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普周四在白宫接待俄罗斯和乌克兰代表团之后。
上周在赫尔松南部地区停火后，她呼吁乌克兰实现“更持久”的停火。
她感谢泽伦斯基和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，但没有提及战争的起源。这场战争始于普京于 2022 年 2 月对乌克兰发动全面入侵，造成数千平民伤亡和数百万人流离失所。
俄罗斯占领的乌克兰城镇奥列什基的数百名面临饥饿和持续轰炸的居民在为期六天的停火期间得以撤离，莫斯科和基辅都将停火归功于特朗普的斡旋。
“无辜人民的生命必须超越战争的界限。我希望奥列什基能够激发更大的和平，”她说。
本周早些时候，滑翔炸弹袭击了扎波罗热附近的一个援助中心，造成多人死亡，随着救援人员深入废墟进行搜索，死亡人数上升至 55 人。
泽伦斯基在周六的电报帖子中补充道，在最近的袭击事件发生后，乌克兰希望美国能够增加双边支持。
他写道：“我们指望双方在安全问题上团结一致，支持乌克兰，谴责俄罗斯的侵略，并加大对普京的制裁压力。

title_en: Ukraine: Russian strikes leave hundreds of thousands without power
title_zh: 乌克兰：俄罗斯的空袭导致数十万人断电
summary: Hundreds of thousands of Ukrainians were left without electricity on Sunday following Russian airstrikes targeting the country's energy infrastructure. Moscow has intensified its attacks as winter approaches, leaving residents in Kyiv and other parts of the co
summary_zh: 周日，俄罗斯针对乌克兰能源基础设施发动空袭，导致数十万乌克兰人断电。
body_en: Hundreds of thousands of Ukrainians were left without electricity on Sunday following Russian airstrikes targeting the country's energy infrastructure. Moscow has intensified its attacks as winter approaches, leaving residents in Kyiv and other parts of the country struggling with power cuts as temperatures continue to drop. Clemence Waller reports.
body_zh: 周日，俄罗斯对乌克兰能源基础设施进行空袭，导致数十万乌克兰人断电。随着冬季临近，莫斯科加强了袭击力度，导致基辅和该国其他地区的居民因气温持续下降而面临断电的困境。克莱门斯·沃勒报道。

title_en: Iran executes three men for 'armed unrest' after January protests
title_zh: 一月份抗议活动后，伊朗以“武装骚乱”罪处决了三名男子
summary: It is claimed Hassan Dioband, Hamid Kazemi and Reza Zanganeh were part of anti-government protests earlier this year.
summary_zh: 据称哈桑·迪奥班德、哈米德·卡泽米和礼萨·赞加内参加了今年早些时候的反政府抗议活动。
body_en: Iran has executed three men accused of carrying out armed unrest during January's anti-government protests, according to state media.

Hassan Dioband, Hamid Kazemi and Reza Zanganeh were accused of throwing Molotov cocktails and grenades, using bladed weapons and firearms, and setting fire to public facilities in the city of Karaj, west of Tehran, Iran's state news agency Tasnim , external reported.
The executions are the latest in a series linked to the protests, including those of people accused of having ties to Israel and the United States.
The number of executions in Iran has increased since US-Israeli strikes on the Islamic Republic began in late February.
The protest movement initially sparked in December last year by the high cost of living rapidly evolved into widespread anti-government demonstrations that peaked on 8 and 9 of January.
Iranian authorities reported more than 3,000 deaths, and blamed the violence on "terrorist acts" orchestrated by the US and Israel.
However foreign-based NGOs gave higher figures and the BBC received multiple accounts from Iranians of security forces opening fire on unarmed protesters.

Tasnim reported that the three men were executed after the Supreme Court upheld their convictions and found them guilty of "participating in operational activities on behalf of the Israeli Zionist regime, the United States and hostile groups".
The damage allegedly included an electricity substation in Karaj which caused power outages in some areas.
Dioband was arrested on 11 January after investigations identified him as a suspect in attacks on public property and incitement to violence.
Ten others accused of taking part in the unrest under his supervision were later arrested.
Reuters news agency reports that they received prison terms of 5 to 10 years.
The latest executions in Iran come after the UN human rights chief Volker Türk said he was alarmed by the rise in death penalties .
In August, Türk said at least 56 people had been executed on national security-related charges since 19 March, including 27 in cases linked to January's nationwide anti-government protests.
Iran is thought to be the world's second-most prolific executioner after China. Last year, it put to death at least 2,159 people, according to Amnesty International.
The human rights group said that was the highest figure on record since 1981 and included 45 executions of suspected dissidents on national security-related charges.

Some Iranians fear the regime is now more entrenched - and ready for revenge
Executions in Iran estimated to have doubled in 2025, report says
body_zh: 据官方媒体报道，伊朗已处决了三名被控在一月份反政府抗议期间发动武装骚乱的男子。
据伊朗国家通讯社塔斯尼姆通讯社外部报道，哈桑·迪奥班德、哈米德·卡泽米和礼萨·赞加内被指控投掷燃烧弹和手榴弹、使用刀片武器和枪支，以及在德黑兰西部卡拉季市的公共设施纵火。
此次处决是与抗议活动有关的一系列事件中的最新一起，其中包括被指控与以色列和美国有联系的人。
自二月底美国和以色列对伊朗伊斯兰共和国发动袭击以来，伊朗被处决的人数有所增加。
去年12月，由于生活成本高昂而引发的抗议运动迅速演变成广泛的反政府示威活动，并于1月8日至9日达到顶峰。
伊朗当局报告有 3000 多人死亡，并将暴力事件归咎于美国和以色列策划的“恐怖行为”。
然而，外国非政府组织提供了更高的数字，英国广播公司 (BBC) 收到了伊朗人的多个报道，称安全部队向手无寸铁的抗议者开枪。
塔斯尼姆报道称，最高法院维持对三人的定罪，并认定他们“代表以色列犹太复国主义政权、美国和敌对团体参与行动”，这三人被处决。
据称，卡拉季的一座变电站遭到破坏，导致部分地区停电。
迪奥班德在调查确定他涉嫌袭击公共财产和煽动暴力后于 1 月 11 日被捕。
另外十名被指控在他的监督下参与骚乱的人后来被捕。
据路透社报道，他们被判处 5 至 10 年徒刑。
伊朗最新的处决是在联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·蒂尔克表示他对死刑增加感到震惊之后发生的。
8 月，蒂尔克表示，自 3 月 19 日以来，至少有 56 人因与国家安全相关的指控被处决，其中 27 人因与 1 月份全国反政府抗议活动有关的案件而被处决。
伊朗被认为是世界上执行死刑数量第二多的国家，仅次于中国。据国际特赦组织称，去年，它至少导致 2,159 人死亡。
该人权组织表示，这是自 1981 年以来有记录以来的最高数字，其中包括因国家安全相关指控而处决的 45 名涉嫌持不同政见者。
伊朗杀害了她十几岁的女儿——现在她正面临着政权
一些伊朗人担心该政权现在更加根深蒂固，并准备进行报复
报告称，2025 年伊朗处决人数估计会增加一倍

title_en: Surgeon having lunch near Krakow shooting undoubtedly saved officer's life, colleague says
title_zh: 同事说，在克拉科夫枪击事件附近吃午餐的外科医生无疑挽救了军官的生命
summary: Further details have emerged about two police officers hailed for preventing a Polish gunman from killing more.
summary_zh: 有关两名警察因阻止一名波兰枪手杀害更多人而受到赞扬的更多细节已经浮出水面。
body_en: One of two surgeons who treated victims on the streets in the aftermath of a mass shooting in Krakow, Poland said his colleague"undoubtedly" saved the life of a gravely injured police officer.
The pair were eating near the city's Main Market Square on Saturday when a gunman began firing at random, killing six and injuring 15.
The doctors raced to treat both the attacker and two officers shot while subduing the perpetrator.
On Sunday, the officers - both hailed as "true heroes" by the prime minister for preventing further deaths - emerged from comas.
Prosecutors launched a terror investigation after ministers previously said the 24-year-old Polish attacker - who remains in a critical condition - was apparently inspired by "far-right ideologies".
A British national and Austrian woman were among those killed alongside four Poles.
Professor Michal Pędziwiatr and Dr Mateusz Wierdak were having lunch in central Krakow with their families when they heard gunshots, local media reported.
"Suddenly my son ran up and said: 'Dad, they're shooting at people there, people are falling to the ground'," Pędziwiatr told news outlet Fakt.
Pędziwiatr said when they got to the scene, they treated both the apparent attacker and the police officers.
"When it comes to saving lives, it doesn't matter who is who," he added.
Once the shooting stopped, Pędziwiatr said he took care of the other victims and the perpetrator, while Wierdak began working on the police officer who was shot in the chest during the gunfight.
"He, to put it colloquially, stuffed all the bandages into [the police officer's] chest and stuck his hands in," he told Fakt.
"If not for that, I don't know how things would have turned out, as there was a long wait for the ambulance."
Meanwhile, Pędziwiatr said he called John Paul II Hospital where the Department of Thoracic and Cardiac Surgery is located.
"I insisted they take him there because, in my opinion, he had the best chance of survival there, where there were specialists for precisely this type of injury," he told Fakt.
According to local media, Wierdak is a renowned surgeon in Krakow. The University Hospital in Krakow states Pędziwiatr is head of General, Oncological, Metabolic and Emergency Surgery.
The police officers have been identified as senior constables Jakub Kulik and Artur Morański.
The attacker has not yet been named by authorities.
When his house was searched after the attack in central Krakow, the bodies of his parents and sister were found.
The National Public Prosecutor's Office in Poland launched an investigation into the attack with a unit specialising in "terrorist offences" taking the lead.
body_zh: 波兰克拉科夫发生大规模枪击事件后，两名在街头救治受害者的外科医生之一表示，他的同事“毫无疑问”拯救了一名受重伤的警察的生命。
周六，两人在该市主要集市广场附近吃饭时，一名枪手开始随意开枪，造成 6 人死亡、15 人受伤。
医生们赶紧救治袭击者和两名在制服肇事者时中枪的警察。
周日，这两名警员从昏迷中苏醒，他们因防止更多死亡而被总理誉为“真正的英雄”。
部长们此前表示，这名仍处于危急状态的 24 岁波兰袭击者显然受到了“极右意识形态”的启发，随后检察官展开了恐怖调查。
遇难者包括一名英国公民和奥地利妇女以及四名波兰人。
据当地媒体报道，Michal Pędziwiatr 教授和 Mateusz Wierdak 博士正在克拉科夫市中心与家人共进午餐，突然听到枪声。
彭兹维亚特告诉新闻媒体 Fakt：“突然，我儿子跑过来说：‘爸爸，他们向那里的人开枪，人们倒在地上’。”
彭兹维亚特说，当他们到达现场时，他们治疗了明显的袭击者和警察。
“在拯救生命方面，谁是谁并不重要，”他补充道。
枪击停止后，彭兹维亚特表示，他照顾了其他受害者和行凶者，而维尔达克则开始照顾在枪战中胸部中弹的警官。
“通俗地说，他把所有绷带都塞进了（警察）的胸口，然后把手伸了进去，”他告诉 Fakt。
“如果不是这样，我不知道事情会怎样，因为等救护车的时间很长。”
与此同时，Pędziwiatr 说，他给胸心外科所在的约翰·保罗二世医院打了电话。
“我坚持要求他们把他带到那里，因为在我看来，他在那里生存的机会最大，那里有专门治疗这种类型伤害的专家，”他告诉 Fakt。
据当地媒体报道，维尔达克是克拉科夫著名的外科医生。克拉科夫大学医院表示，Pędziwiatr 是普通外科、肿瘤外科、代谢外科和急诊外科的负责人。
这两名警察被确认为高级警员雅库布·库里克（Jakub Kulik）和阿图尔·莫兰斯基（Artur Morański）。
当局尚未透露袭击者的姓名。
克拉科夫市中心袭击事件发生后，当他的房子被搜查时，发现了他父母和妹妹的尸体。
波兰国家检察官办公室对此次袭击事件展开调查，专门负责“恐怖主义犯罪”的部门牵头。

title_en: 'Flat', 'tired', 'cynical': Unusually gloomy Kiwis deliver New Zealand's tightest election in years
title_zh: “平淡”、“疲倦”、“愤世嫉俗”：异常悲观的新西兰人带来了新西兰多年来最紧张的选举
summary: The national mood is low, and faith in politics even lower - with voters deserting the major parties at the polls.
summary_zh: 全国情绪低落，对政治的信心更低——选民在投票中抛弃了主要政党。
body_en: New Zealand voted in a new government as fog choked the capital, Wellington, on Saturday - and the mood was as palpable as the grey weather.
"It's pretty flat," 21-year-old Imogen Vlutger says. "There's this kind of apathy and a bit of dread."
"Tired. I think we're all tired," Symone, 28, admits.
"I didn't even vote," one man in his 40s sheepishly confesses. He couldn't bring himself to tick any of the boxes, he explains, declining to chat further.
"Wellington's a bit of a bubble," another voter says, expressing a caveat I heard often, before describing feeling disillusioned.
But polling shows this is a pervasive sentiment across the country: the national mood is low and faith in politics is even lower.
More than half the country no longer sees it as a land of opportunity, a recent study found, while a similar portion fears that the future looks even worse.

Many Kiwis feel the economy is in ruins, there are no jobs, the cost of living has become sky high, the sense of community that used to be a source of national pride is breaking down and there's no sense of genuine progress on policy solutions.
A record number of them are abandoning ship in search of brighter futures elsewhere.
Saturday's election also saw a record number of voters desert the two major parties, giving neither a clear mandate.

But it brought new highs for parties across the spectrum: the left-leaning Greens, the right-wing libertarian Act Party and the centrist Opportunity Party – the latter of which had never won a seat in parliament before but could now hold the balance of power with seven.

"You have voted to change New Zealand politics for good," the party's ecstatic leader Quilae Wong told Kiwis on election night. "I personally came into this because I was frustrated at the slow pace of change."
It will likely be weeks before we know exactly who will make up the governing coalition and what deals have been made to form it.
But this is only the first of many challenges facing whoever is the next prime minister of a country at a crossroads.
For a long time, the country was viewed as a land of milk and honey – literally – for those who worked hard, with its people ranking amongst the most positive in the world.

A satisfying career, access to quality healthcare, and a close network of family and friends – which research suggests are the three most important building blocks of a happy life – were all there for the taking, University of Auckland Prof Robert MacCulloch says.
"The lifestyle was good," the world-leader in the study of happiness economics tells the BBC. "You weren't the highest paid, but you could get by nicely."
Many who spoke to the BBC said the country's decline accelerated into a dive during the Covid pandemic.

Unemployment is now at an 11-year high and rising. For Kiwis aged under 24, things haven't been this bad in three decades: jobs are so scarce that one in three either cannot get enough work or have none at all.
Michael Dawson says he did everything he thought he was supposed to: finished school, studied a trade and obtained a qualification, and has applied for dozens of jobs.
body_zh: 周六，新西兰在首都惠灵顿大雾笼罩之际，对新政府进行了投票，人们的情绪就像灰蒙蒙的天气一样明显。
“这里非常平坦，”21 岁的 Imogen Vlutger 说道。 “有一种冷漠和一点恐惧。”
“累了。我想我们都累了，”28 岁的西蒙承认道。
“我什至没有投票，”一名 40 多岁的男子羞涩地承认。他解释说，他无法让自己勾选任何一个框，并拒绝进一步交谈。
另一位选民表示：“惠灵顿有点像泡沫。”他表达了我经常听到的警告，然后描述了自己的幻灭感。
但民意调查显示，这种情绪在全国范围内普遍存在：国民情绪低落，对政治的信心更低。
最近的一项研究发现，超过一半的国家不再将其视为充满机遇的土地，而相似比例的人则担心未来看起来更糟。
许多新西兰人感到经济已是一片废墟，没有就业机会，生活成本极高，曾经作为民族自豪感源泉的社区意识正在崩溃，而且政策解决方案没有取得真正进展。
其中弃船去别处寻找更光明未来的人数创历史新高。
周六的选举中，抛弃两大政党的选民人数也创历史新高，没有给予任何一方明确的授权。
但这为各派政党带来了新的高度：左倾绿党、右翼自由主义行动党和中间派机会党——后者以前从未在议会中赢得过席位，但现在可以以七个席位保持权力平衡。
“你们投票决定永远改变新西兰的政治，”该党欣喜若狂的领导人 Quilae Wong 在选举之夜告诉新西兰人。 “我个人参与其中是因为我对缓慢的变化步伐感到沮丧。”
我们可能需要几周时间才能确切知道谁将组成执政联盟以及为组建该联盟达成了哪些协议。
但这只是处于十字路口的国家下一任总理所面临的众多挑战中的第一个。
长期以来，这个国家被视为勤劳者的牛奶和蜂蜜之地，其人民是世界上最积极的人之一。
奥克兰大学教授罗伯特·麦卡洛克（Robert MacCulloch）表示，令人满意的职业、获得优质医疗保健的机会以及亲密的家人和朋友网络——研究表明这是幸福生活的三个最重要的组成部分——这一切都可以获取。
“生活方式很好，”幸福经济学研究的世界领先者告诉英国广播公司。 “你的薪水不是最高的，但你可以过得很好。”
许多接受 BBC 采访的人士表示，新冠大流行期间，该国的经济衰退加速下滑。
失业率目前处于 11 年来的最高水平，并且还在不断上升。对于 24 岁以下的新西兰人来说，三十年来情况从未如此糟糕：工作机会如此稀缺，以至于三分之一的人要么找不到足够的工作，要么根本没有工作。
迈克尔·道森说，他做了他认为自己应该做的一切：完成学业，学习一门手艺并获得资格，并申请了数十份工作。

title_en: Ukraine: Russia hits Kyiv with airstrikes ahead of trilateral talks
title_zh: 乌克兰：三边会谈前俄罗斯空袭基辅
summary: The strikes hit a major bridge and energy facilities in the Kyiv region. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy accused Moscow of trying to "push" Ukraine "into a blackout" ahead of talks in Abu Dhabi.
summary_zh: 袭击袭击了基辅地区的一座主要桥梁和能源设施。总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基指责莫斯科试图“推动”乌克兰“
body_en: Russia launched strikes on Kyiv and surrounding areas overnight, Russian and Ukrainian authorities said on Saturday.
Russia's Defense Ministry said the strikes hit the Northern Bridge and the Meridian Plant.
Moscow said that the bridge was being used by the Ukrainian military to transport weapons and military equipment, while the plant is used to produce Flamingo cruise missiles.
It said the strikes damaged several energy and industrial facilities in the Kyiv region, as well as an electricity substation in the neighboring Zhytomyr region and a cargo vessel in the Black Sea.
What have Ukrainian authorities said about the attacks?

Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko confirmed the strikes on the Northern Bridge, adding that the Ukrainian capital found itself in an "extremely difficult" situation regarding power, heating and water supplies. Overnight temperatures dropped to 0 degrees Celsius (32 degrees Fahrenheit) in the city.
The Kyiv region's governor, Tymur Tkachenko, said energy facilities in three of its districts had been hit.
Ukrainian authorities said that one person was killed and eight were wounded in the overnight attack.
In a statement on social media , president Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that Russia used 172 drones and 36 ballistic missiles during the attack.
He said that Russia was trying to "push Kyiv … and the entire country into a blackout" and repeated his call for increased support from the United States .
Russia has stepped up airstrikes on Ukraine in recent months, targeting energy infrastructure and major cities, and more recently hitting bridges.

The strikes come days before a fourth round of trilateral talks between Kyiv, Moscow and Washington in Abu Dhabi in the United Arab Emirates.
Previous rounds of US-brokered talks have failed to achieve any breakthroughs, with territorial and security questions remaining major points of contention.
On Friday, US President Donald Trump said the war could be close to being settled and that he envisioned a "big, beautiful agreement" with Moscow that involves "all of Europe."
Last Friday, a six-day local ceasefire in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky in the southern Kherson region enabled the evacuation of some 800 residents.
The brief truce was brokered by US First Lady Melania Trump.

body_zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰当局周六表示，俄罗斯连夜对基辅及周边地区发动了袭击。
俄罗斯国防部表示，袭击袭击了北桥和子午线工厂。
莫斯科表示，乌克兰军方使用这座桥运输武器和军事装备，而该工厂则用于生产火烈鸟巡航导弹。
据称，袭击损坏了基辅地区的多个能源和工业设施，以及邻近日托米尔地区的一座变电站和黑海的一艘货船。
乌克兰当局对袭击事件有何评论？
基辅市长维塔利·克里琴科证实了北桥遭到袭击的消息，并补充说，乌克兰首都在电力、供暖和供水方面处于“极其困难”的境地。该市夜间气温降至 0 摄氏度（32 华氏度）。
基辅地区州长泰穆尔·特卡琴科表示，该地区三个地区的能源设施遭到袭击。
乌克兰当局表示，夜间袭击造成 1 人死亡、8 人受伤。
总统泽连斯基在社交媒体上发表声明称，俄罗斯在袭击中动用了 172 架无人机和 36 枚弹道导弹。
他表示，俄罗斯正试图“让基辅……以及整个国家陷入停电”，并再次呼吁美国加大支持力度。
近几个月来，俄罗斯加强了对乌克兰的空袭，目标是能源基础设施和主要城市，最近还袭击了桥梁。

title_en: Seven dead and more than 100 injured after trains collide in Egypt
title_zh: 埃及火车相撞造成7人死亡、100多人受伤
summary: Several carriages derailed after two trains travelling in the same direction crashed outside the city of Giza.
summary_zh: 两列同向行驶的火车在吉萨城外相撞，导致多节车厢脱轨。
body_en: At least seven people have died in a train crash near the Egyptian city of Giza, with more than 100 injured.
The country's railway authority said two trains travelling south from Giza and Cairo collided, causing several carriages to derail and fall down an embankment.
Images from the scene showed people looking inside overturned carriages for injured passengers as a massive emergency response was launched.
Egyptian President Abdul Fattah al-Sisi said he had ordered state authorities to "investigate the circumstances of the accident, and hold accountable anyone found to have been negligent".
The public prosecutor's office warned the death toll could rise.
The government said hospitals in the area had been put "on heightened alert" as they dealt with a massive influx of patients.
Egypt's health minister Dr Khaled Abdel Ghaffar said people were being treated for broken bones and head injuries.
The Egyptian Red Crescent said it was providing aid and psychological support to victims and their families at the scene.
The driver of one of the trains was among those who died in the crash, the ministry confirmed.

The first train involved in the crash was travelling from Giza to Fayoum, south of Cairo, when it crashed into the rear of another service heading south from Cairo to Aswan, which was stationary on the tracks.
Images from the scene showed some carriages had overturned, with the body of at least one appearing to have split in two.
Trains between Giza and the Upper Egypt region were suspended as cranes were dispatched to remove the wrecked trains. The railway authority has not said how long it expects this to take.

The collision occurred in the area between Kafr Ammar and Al-Raqqa stations in Al-Ayyat, close to where Egypt's deadliest train tragedy occurred in February 2002, when a fire engulfed a passenger train travelling from Cairo to Luxor.
In that incident, more than 370 people were officially reported killed, although some estimates put the toll considerably higher.
Two further crashes in the area in 2009 killed dozens more.
There were calls in Egypt on Sunday for the transport minister to resign over the latest deadly rail disaster.
Foreign leaders and dignitaries have shared condolences and support for the victims.
Saudi Arabia's ministry of foreign affairs expressed "solidarity" with Egypt and wished those hurt a speedy recovery.
Turkey's ambassador to Egypt wrote on X that he extended "heartfelt condolences and sincere sympathy" to the victims, their families, and the Egyptian people.
body_zh: 埃及吉萨市附近发生的火车相撞事故已造成至少 7 人死亡、100 多人受伤。
该国铁路部门表示，两列从吉萨和开罗向南行驶的火车相撞，导致几节车厢脱轨并坠落路堤。
现场图像显示，在大规模紧急响应启动之际，人们在翻倒的车厢内寻找受伤的乘客。
埃及总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西表示，他已命令国家当局“调查事故情况，并追究任何疏忽的人的责任”。
检察官办公室警告死亡人数可能会上升。
政府表示，该地区的医院因应对大量涌入的患者而处于“高度戒备”状态。
埃及卫生部长哈立德·阿卜杜勒·加法尔博士表示，人们正在接受骨折和头部受伤的治疗。
埃及红新月会表示正在为现场受害者及其家人提供援助和心理支持。
该部证实，其中一列火车的司机是在事故中丧生的人之一。
发生事故的第一列火车当时正从吉萨开往开罗以南的法尤姆，当时它撞上了另一列从开罗向南开往阿斯旺的火车的后部，该火车停在铁轨上。
现场图像显示，一些车厢翻倒，至少一辆车厢的尸体似乎裂成两半。
吉萨和上埃及地区之间的火车被暂停，并派出起重机来移除失事的火车。铁路局尚未透露预计需要多长时间。
相撞事故发生在 Al-Ayyat 的 Kafr Ammar 站和 Al-Raqqa 站之间的地区，该地区靠近 2002 年 2 月发生埃及最致命的火车悲剧的地方，当时一场大火吞没了从开罗开往卢克索的客运列车。
官方报告称，在那次事件中，有超过 370 人死亡，但一些估计数字要高得多。
2009 年该地区又发生两起事故，造成数十人死亡。
周日，埃及有人呼吁交通部长因最新的致命铁路灾难而辞职。
外国领导人和政要纷纷向遇难者表示哀悼和支持。
沙特阿拉伯外交部表达了对埃及的“声援”，并祝愿那些受伤的人早日康复。
土耳其驻埃及大使于X日写道，他向遇难者及其家属和埃及人民表示“衷心哀悼和诚挚慰问”。

title_en: Man United earn 4-4 draw against Aston Villa but remain in relegation zone
title_zh: 曼联4-4战平阿斯顿维拉，但仍处于降级区
summary: Michael Carrick's team continue forgettable season with last-gasp draw at Old Trafford in front of angry home fans.
summary_zh: 迈克尔·卡里克的球队在愤怒的主场球迷面前在老特拉福德球场最后时刻逼平了球队，继续着令人难忘的赛季。
body_en: Share Manchester United fight back to draw 4-4 with Aston Villa as fans pile pressure on social media
Manchester United pulled off a dramatic late comeback to earn a 4-4 draw against Aston Villa in front of their angry home fans amid a torrid time at the Premier League club.
United conceded two goals within the first four minutes of the high-stakes fixture at Old Trafford in Manchester on Sunday, but fought back with two stoppage-time goals and shared the spoils.

The 13-time Premier League champions remain in the relegation zone in the Premier League table, sitting in 18th place with eight points from 10 games. But their manager Michael Carrick will breathe a sigh of relief after avoiding a fifth loss and will again hope to avoid getting sacked.
Carrick was seconds away from heading into the international break on the back of another devastating defeat that would surely have led to his dismissal.
But United struck twice in the six minutes of additional time through Joshua Zirkzee and Patrick Dorgu to leave their manager’s future open to question.
He had earned a stay of execution when United’s hierarchy allowed him to remain in charge despite last weekend’s loss at Chelsea.
United responded by ending a nine-match winless run in all competitions as they came from two goals down to beat Roma 3-2 in the Champions League on Tuesday.
But Man United, who have only three wins in 15 games this season, were back in turmoil when they quickly went 2-0 down.
Alysson struck in the first minute with a shot that squirmed under keeper Senne Lammens.
Nicolas Jackson slotted in the second three minutes later after a weak save from Lammens pushed the ball into his path.
Bruno Fernandes got one back with a 16th-minute penalty after Boubacar Kamara fouled Matheus Cunha, before former Villa midfielder Youri Tielemans slammed in United’s 44th-minute equaliser.
Villa’s John McGinn converted a 48th-minute penalty following Diogo Dalot’s clumsy challenge on Alysson.
Leon Goretzka poked in Villa’s fourth from close-range after United’s Leny Yoro headed against his own crossbar in the 53rd minute.
Yet Zirkzee’s stoppage-time finish gave United hope and Dorgu headed their dramatic equaliser in the final seconds after a weak punch from Villa keeper Zion Suzuki.
Carrick wore a bewildered look on his face as he walked down the tunnel with United next in action at Liverpool on November 22.
Chelsea arrived at the Stadium of Light hoping to bolster their bid to qualify for the Champions League via a top-four finish.
Instead, they departed red-faced after an embarrassing loss to third-bottom Sunderland, who celebrated a league victory for only the second time this season.
Fifth-placed Chelsea have already been beaten four times in 10 league matches under former Real Madrid boss Xabi Alonso.
Chelsea were rocked in the 36th minute when Enzo Le Fee converted a penalty after Brian Brobbey was up-ended by Levi Colwill.
body_zh: 球迷在社交媒体上施压，曼联反击以4-4战平阿斯顿维拉
曼联在比赛最后时刻戏剧性地逆转，在愤怒的主场球迷面前4-4战平阿斯顿维拉，而这支英超俱乐部正经历着一段艰难的时期。
周日在曼彻斯特老特拉福德举行的这场高风险比赛的前四分钟内，曼联就丢了两个进球，但在补时阶段凭借两个进球进行了反击，分享了战利品。
13届英超冠军球队在英超积分榜上仍处于降级区，10场比赛积8分排名第18位。但他们的主教练迈克尔·卡里克在避免第五次失利后将松一口气，并再次希望避免被解雇。
卡里克距离进入国际比赛日只有几秒​​钟的时间，因为另一场毁灭性的失败肯定会导致他被解雇。
但曼联在补时六分钟内通过约书亚·齐尔克泽和帕特里克·多尔古两次进球，让他们的主教练的未来受到质疑。
尽管上周末输给了切尔西，但曼联的高层允许他继续执掌球队，因此他获得了缓刑。
曼联在周二的欧冠联赛中以两球落后的情况下以3-2击败罗马，结束了各项赛事九场不胜的局面。
但本赛季15场比赛仅取得3场胜利的曼联，很快就0-2落后，再次陷入混乱。
阿利森在第一分钟射门，但在门将塞内·拉门斯的脚下蠕动。
三分钟后，尼古拉斯·杰克逊在拉门斯的一次微弱扑救后将球推入了第二个球。
在布巴卡尔·卡马拉对马修斯·库尼亚犯规后，布鲁诺·费尔南德斯在第 16 分钟点球扳回一球，随后前维拉中场尤里·蒂勒曼斯在第 44 分钟为曼联扳平比分。
第 48 分钟，迪奥戈·达洛特 (Diogo Dalot) 笨拙地挑战阿利森 (Alysson)，维拉队的约翰·麦金 (John McGinn) 主罚点球。
第 53 分钟，莱昂·格雷茨卡 (Leon Goretzka) 近距离射入维拉第四球，曼联队的莱尼·约罗 (Leny Yoro) 在第 53 分钟头球击中自己的横梁。
然而齐尔克泽在伤停补时阶段的进球给曼联带来了希望，在维拉门将铃木锡安的一记微弱一拳之后，多尔古在最后几秒头球扳平比分。
11 月 22 日，当卡里克随曼联对阵利物浦的比赛走入球员通道时，他脸上带着困惑的表情。
切尔西抵达光明球场，希望通过前四名的成绩来增强他们获得欧冠资格的机会。
相反，他们在尴尬地输给倒数第三的桑德兰后红着脸离开了，桑德兰本赛季第二次庆祝联赛胜利。
排名第五的切尔西在前皇马主帅哈维·阿隆索的带领下，在 10 场联赛中已经被击败了 4 次。
第 36 分钟，布莱恩·布罗比 (Brian Brobbey) 被列维·科尔威尔 (Levi Colwill) 倒地后，恩佐·勒费 (Enzo Le Fee) 主罚点球，切尔西队彻底震惊。

title_en: Houthis say at least 33 killed in Saudi air strike
title_zh: 胡塞武装称沙特空袭造成至少25人死亡
summary: Saudi Arabia, which leads a coalition fighting the Houthis in Yemen, has not commented.
summary_zh: 领导在也门打击胡塞武装的联盟的沙特阿拉伯尚未发表评论。
body_en: Media linked to the Houthi movement in Yemen say at least 33 people, including women and children, have been killed in air strikes by Saudi Arabia.
There has been no comment from the Saudi-led coalition backing the internationally recognised government in Yemen.

Live video footage on Al Masirah - a television station run by the Houthis - has shown rescuers pulling bodies out of the rubble of several buildings in al-Shariyah, a town to the east of the capital, Sanaa.
The bodies of young children can be seen among those dug out from the ruins.
The television station has also shown a number of injured people being carried on stretchers to hospital.
Saba news agency, which is also run by the Houthis, said the attack was carried out by Saudi Arabia on Saturday. It added that 39 people had been injured.
The Saudis have led a coalition that has been fighting the Houthis for more than a decade in support of Yemen's internationally recognised government.
The war in Yemen had been dormant for several years but reignited as a result of the Iran war.
A truce began to fall apart when Saudi Arabia struck the airport in Sanaa - which is controlled by the Houthis - to prevent an Iranian plane landing there.

The Tehran-backed Houthis subsequently targeted Abha airport in Saudi Arabia, then began hitting Saudi ships that have been using the Red Sea off the coast of Yemen as an alternative oil export route to the Strait of Hormuz.
Major fighting has since resumed in Yemen between the Houthis and forces fighting for the Saudi-backed government of Yemen.
On Friday, an attack on a market in Taiz province, which has been the focus of much of the recent fighting, is reported to have killed 30 people.
The Houthis accused the Saudis of carrying out the strike, while government forces accused the Houthis of having fired a missile at the site.
The United Nations says more than 1,600 people have been killed and more than 300,000 displaced since fighting resumed.
The Saudis have regularly bombed Houthi positions, while the group has fired multiple missiles at targets inside Saudi Arabia, including airports and oil facilities.
Hours before the strike that hit al-Shariyah, the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a missile heading towards Riyadh.
The Saudi Ministry of Energy later said the Aramco tower had been hit by falling shrapnel in what it said was an attempted attack.
The state-owned oil company's building suffered minor damage.
A Houthi leader, Mahdi al-Mashat, has vowed that the group will take revenge for the latest attacks in Yemen.
body_zh: 与也门胡塞运动有关的媒体称，至少 33 人在沙特阿拉伯的空袭中丧生，其中包括妇女和儿童。
支持国际公认的也门政府的沙特领导的联盟尚未发表评论。
胡塞武装运营的电视台 Al Masirah 的现场视频显示，救援人员从首都萨那东部城镇 al-Shariyah 的几栋建筑废墟中拉出尸体。
从废墟中挖出的尸体中可以看到幼儿的尸体。
电视台还播放了一些伤者被担架抬往医院的画面。
同样由胡塞武装管理的萨巴通讯社称，周六的袭击是沙特阿拉伯发动的。它补充说，有39人受伤。
沙特领导的联盟十多年来一直与胡塞武装作战，以支持国际公认的也门政府。
也门战争已沉寂数年，但因伊朗战争而重新燃起。
当沙特阿拉伯袭击胡塞武装控制的萨那机场以阻止伊朗计划降落时，休战协议开始破裂。
德黑兰支持的胡塞武装随后袭击了沙特阿拉伯的艾卜哈机场，然后开始袭击沙特船只，这些船只一直在也门海岸附近的红海作为通往霍尔木兹海峡的替代石油出口路线。
此后，也门胡塞武装和沙特支持的也门政府的武装力量之间又重新爆发了大规模战斗。
周五，塔伊兹省的一个市场遭到袭击，据报道，该袭击已造成 30 人死亡，该袭击一直是近期战斗的焦点。
胡塞武装指责沙特发动了这次袭击，而政府军则指责胡塞武装向该地点发射了导弹。
联合国表示，自战斗重新爆发以来，已有超过 1,600 人丧生，超过 30 万人流离失所。
沙特经常轰炸胡塞武装阵地，该组织还向沙特阿拉伯境内的目标发射多枚导弹，包括机场和石油设施。
在袭击 al-Shariyah 的袭击发生前几个小时，沙特领导的联军表示拦截了一枚飞向利雅得的导弹。
沙特能源部后来表示，沙特阿美石油公司塔楼被坠落的弹片击中，据称这是一次未遂袭击。
国有石油公司的大楼受到轻微损坏。
胡塞武装领导人迈赫迪·马沙特誓言，该组织将为也门最近发生的袭击事件进行报复。

title_en: Collision of two trains in Egypt kills at least seven
title_zh: 埃及两列火车相撞 至少七人死亡
summary: President orders prompt investigation after one train derails in collision in al-Ayyat about 30 miles from Cairo Seven people were killed and more than 100 injured when two trains collided on Sunday south of the Egyptian capital, Cairo, officials said. The cra
summary_zh: 距开罗约 30 英里的艾亚特一列火车发生碰撞脱轨，总统下令立即调查，造成七人死亡，多人死亡
body_en: President orders prompt investigation after one train derails in collision in al-Ayyat about 30 miles from Cairo
Seven people were killed and more than 100 injured when two trains collided on Sunday south of the Egyptian capital, Cairo, officials said.

The crash occurred in al-Ayyat district in Giza province, about 30 miles south of Cairo, when a train travelling to Fayoum province crashed into the rear of a train heading to the southern province of Aswan, according to the transport ministry.
An inspection indicated that the Cairo-Aswan train had been stationary on the same track, officials said.

Train derailments and crashes are common in Egypt, where the railway system has a history of mismanagement and poor maintenance of equipment. In recent years the government has announced modernisation initiatives to improve its railways.
Ayman Gamal, a resident of Kafr Girza in al-Ayyat where the crash occurred, said people rushed to the scene, pulled out survivors and called ambulances.
Gamal said he saw about 80 of the injured being taken by ambulances to hospital. He said some passengers were trapped inside one of the carriages of the stationary train and died.
Egypt’s president, Abdel Fatah al-Sisi, said in a social media post that he had ordered a prompt investigation.
Emergency teams and cranes were dispatched to the scene to clear the wreckage and restore train services to their normal schedule as soon as possible, the Egyptian railway authority said.
Last September, a train driver and his assistant were injured after two freight trains collided in the same district.
Egypt’s deadliest train crash was in 2002 when more than 300 people were killed after a fire broke out on an overnight train journeying from Cairo to southern Egypt.
body_zh: 一列火车在距开罗约30英里的al-Ayyat发生碰撞事故后，总统下令立即进行调查
官员称，周日两列火车在埃及首都开罗以南相撞，造成 7 人死亡、100 多人受伤。
据交通部称，事故发生在开罗以南约30英里的吉萨省艾亚特地区，当时一列开往法尤姆省的火车与开往南部阿斯旺省的火车尾部相撞。
官员们表示，检查表明开罗至阿斯旺的列车一直停在同一条轨道上。
火车脱轨和撞车事故在埃及很常见，该国铁路系统有管理不善和设备维护不善的历史。近年来，政府宣布了改善铁路的现代化举措。
艾曼·贾迈勒 (Ayman Gamal) 是事故发生地艾亚特 (al-Ayyat) 卡夫吉尔扎 (Kafr Girza) 的居民，他说人们赶到现场，救出幸存者并叫了救护车。
加迈勒说，他看到大约 80 名伤者被救护车送往医院。他说，一些乘客被困在静止火车的一节车厢内并死亡。
埃及总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西在社交媒体帖子中表示，他已下令立即展开调查。
埃及铁路局表示，应急小组和起重机已赶赴现场清理残骸，并尽快恢复列车正常运行。
去年9月，同一地区两列货运列车相撞，一名火车司机和他的助手受伤。
埃及最严重的火车事故发生在 2002 年，当时一列从开罗开往埃及南部的夜间火车发生火灾，造成 300 多人死亡。

title_en: South Africa elections: ANC marks its worst-ever performance
title_zh: 南非选举：非国大创下有史以来最差表现
summary: The African National Congress, the party of late Nobel Prize winner Nelson Mandela, slumped to its worst-ever result in South Africa's municipal election. The voters blame the ANC for water and electricity shortages.
summary_zh: 已故诺贝尔奖获得者纳尔逊·曼德拉领导的非洲人国民大会党在南非市政选举中的表现跌至历史最低水平
body_en: South Africa's African National Congress (ANC) turned in a historically poor election performance , with the the final tally published on Sunday giving them less than 31% of the vote in Wednesday's municipal polls .
Their closes rival, the Democratic Alliance (DA), won just under 25% of the vote.

The ANC also lost its majority in six of the eight metropolitan regions, South Africa 's Electoral Commission said on Saturday. With no outright winner declared in several major cities, politicians are expected enter tough coalition talks to form municipal governments.
ANC secretary general says outcome 'catastrophic'

While the ANC remains the most popular party in the country, they have been struggling with growing backlash from voters. In 2026, many South Africans are frustrated by water and electricity shortages, with the ANC taking the blame for the poor state of municipalities. High unemployment, crime, and widespread corruption are high on the public agenda.

ANC leader, and South African president, Cyril Ramaphosa , has not yet addressed his party's poor performance. In his weekly presidential letter, however, he admitted that "municipal failures have contributed to declining public trust and confidence in democratic governance."
On Saturday, ANC Secretary-General Fikile Mbalula told reporters that the ANC needs to work on winning back public confidence.
"We cannot ask the people to trust us merely because of our history," Mbalula said.
"This has been a very catastrophic outcome for the ANC ... as much as we are the largest party, it has been catastrophic for the movement," he added.

The ANC had governed with an absolute majority for most of its history up until the general election in 2024 saw it lose an outright parliamentary majority for the first time in South Africa's democratic era.
"This is the most severe result that the ANC would have feared," political analyst Daniel Silke told the AFP news agency.

"It's the ANC's worst result in history," Silke said, adding that the result will undermine the ANC's ability to exert authority on the local and national level. The results could also provide a bellwether of voter sentiment ahead of the 2029 general elections.
Once led by Nelson Mandela , the ANC was instrumental in ending apartheid, and took and power in 1994 after South Africa became a democracy.

But over the past decade, it has steadily performed worse in one election after another. In 2024, the ANC secured just over 40% in the 2024 national polls and 46% at the previous municipal elections in 2021.
After losing the absolute majority in 2024, the ANC formed a cross-party national unity government with all the parties represented in parliament, which is still in power.

The ANC's decline comes amid disillusionment over corruption, mismanagement and high unemployment. Smaller parties have also emerged across South Africa's political landscape, cutting into the ANC's voter base.

The pro-business, center-right DA is set to keep control of Cape Town after winning an absolute majority. It also performed well in the capital, Pretoria, and economic hub of Johannesburg, and is expected to form coalitions that exclude the ANC.

"All of the cut and thrust that comes with the election is now over, and it is time now... to put together governments that can actually fix these towns and cities," DA leader Geordin Hill-Lewis told reporters.
"We have already reached out to many parties over the last 24 hours and will continue to do so today," he said.
body_zh: 南非非洲人国民大会 (ANC) 的选举表现创历史新低，周日公布的最终计票结果显示，他们在周三的市政民意调查中得票率不足 31%。
他们最接近的竞争对手民主联盟 (DA) 赢得了略低于 25% 的选票。
南非选举委员会周六表示，非国大还失去了八个大都市区中六个地区的多数席位。由于几个主要城市都没有宣布彻底的获胜者，预计政治家们将进入艰难的联合谈判以组建市政府。
非国大秘书长称结果是“灾难性的”
尽管非国大仍然是该国最受欢迎的政党，但他们一直在与选民日益增长的强烈反对作斗争。 2026 年，许多南非人因水电短缺而感到沮丧，非洲人国民大会将城市的糟糕状况归咎于这一问题。高失业率、犯罪和普遍腐败是公众议程上的重要议题。
非国大领导人、南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨尚未解决该党表现不佳的问题。然而，他在每周的总统信中承认，“市政失败导致公众对民主治理的信任和信心下降。”
周六，非国大秘书长菲基尔·姆巴卢拉告诉记者，非国大需要努力赢回公众信心。
姆巴卢拉说：“我们不能仅仅因为我们的历史就要求人们信任我们。”
“这对非国大来说是一个非常灾难性的结果……尽管我们是最大的政党，但这对这场运动来说也是灾难性的，”他补充道。
非国大历史上大部分时间都以绝对多数执政，直到 2024 年大选，该党在南非民主时代首次失去了议会绝对多数席位。
政治分析家丹尼尔·西尔克告诉法新社：“这是非国大担心的最严重的结果。”
西尔克说：“这是非国大历史上最糟糕的结果。”他补充说，这一结果将削弱非国大在地方和国家层面行使权力的能力。结果还可能成为 2029 年大选前选民情绪的风向标。
非国大曾由纳尔逊·曼德拉 (Nelson Mandela) 领导，在结束种族隔离方面发挥了重要作用，并于 1994 年南非成为民主国家后掌权。
但在过去的十年里，它在一次又一次的选举中表现越来越差。 2024 年，非国大在 2024 年全国民意调查中获得略高于 40% 的支持率，在 2021 年上次市政选举中获得 46% 的支持率。
2024年，非国大失去绝对多数席位后，组建了跨党派民族团结政府，各党派均在议会中拥有代表权，目前议会仍在执政。
非国大衰落之际，人们对腐败、管理不善和高失业率感到失望。南非政治格局中也出现了较小的政党，削弱了非国大的选民基础。
这位亲商业的中右翼地方检察官在赢得绝对多数票后将继续控制开普敦。它在首都比勒陀利亚和经济中心约翰内斯堡也表现良好，预计将形成排除非国大的联盟。
民主联盟领导人乔丁·希尔-刘易斯对记者表示：“选举带来的所有激烈竞争现在都已经结束，现在是时候……组建能够真正修复这些城镇的政府了。”
他说：“过去 24 小时内，我们已经与多方进行了接触，今天还将继续这样做。”

title_en: ANC faces bruising defeat in South African local elections with 80% of ballots counted
title_zh: 南非地方选举80%选票已清点 非国大面临惨败
summary: Former liberation movement’s share of national vote almost 14 percentage points below 2021 result The African National Congress is on course to suffer a bruising defeat in South Africa’s local elections, with the once dominant party of Nelson Mandela falling t
summary_zh: 前解放运动在全国选票中所占比例比 2021 年结果低近 14 个百分点
body_en: ANC faces bruising defeat in South African local elections with 80% of ballots counted | ANC (African National Congress)
Former liberation movement’s share of national vote almost 14 percentage points below 2021 result

The African National Congress is on course to suffer a bruising defeat in South Africa’s local elections, with the once dominant party of Nelson Mandela falling to under a third of the vote nationally with more than 80% of ballots counted.

Wednesday’s fragmented vote marks another stage in the decline of the ANC, which has led national governments since the end of white minority apartheid rule in 1994. High unemployment, crime, corruption and poor local service delivery have all contributed to voters turning away from the party .

The former liberation movement is projected to lose its status as the biggest party in the two most populous provinces, Gauteng and KwaZulu-Natal, as parties began coalition negotiations behind closed doors. The final results are expected to be announced on Sunday.

The ANC was on 31.8% of the vote nationally, almost 14 percentage points below its 2021 local election result. The centre-right, white-led Democratic Alliance (DA) had 24.1% of the vote, while the uMkhonto weSizwe (MK) party of the former ANC president Jacob Zuma was on 9.3%.
Turnout also rose in Wednesday’s poll. The election commission estimated that 54.5% of registered voters cast their ballot, up from 46% five years ago.

The final shape of coalitions in some of the country’s biggest cities remained unclear with the final votes still being counted. Senior figures in key parties said they would talk with almost anyone, while keeping negotiating strategies under wraps.

In Johannesburg, South Africa’s commercial capital and biggest city, with 4.8 million people, voters have had to contend with regular water and power cuts , uncollected rubbish and potholes. The municipality, which has seen 10 changes of mayor in the last decade amid unstable coalitions, has admitted to a 220bn rand (£9.9bn) infrastructure spending backlog.

With just over half of votes counted in Johannesburg, the DA was leading with 40%, having run an energetic campaign under Helen Zille, a 75-year-old former Cape Town mayor. The ANC, which leads the current coalition, was in second place on 17.5%. ActionSA, a rightwing party led by Herman Mashaba, was on 15.5%. Mashaba has pledged never to work with Zille, whom he calls “racist”, something she vehemently denies.

Many of the ANC’s township strongholds have yet to report full results. The Council for Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), a respected thinktank, has projected the DA will finish with 34%, the ANC 20% and ActionSA 16.8%.
Coalitions in Gauteng’s three city municipalities are often negotiated together. The DA is leading in all three.

The MK party, led by 84-year-old Zuma as he continues to weather and deny numerous corruption allegations, is expected to displace the ANC as the largest party in KwaZulu-Natal. Founded in 2023, it mixes socially conservative Zulu nationalism with pledges to redistribute land and wealth from white to black South Africans.

With half of votes counted in eThekwini municipality, which contains Durban, the MK had 41%, meaning other parties could form a coalition to keep it out of power. Meanwhile, the DA is projected to maintain its majority in Cape Town, despite growing middle-class anger over rising housing costs .
Voters choose a local councillor and a party, with seats allocated via proportional representation. Councillors will then have two weeks to elect mayors and form municipal governments.
body_zh: 非洲人国民大会在南非地方选举中遭遇惨败，80%的选票已清点ANC（非洲人国民大会）
前解放运动在全国选票中所占比例比 2021 年结果低近 14 个百分点
非洲人国民大会在南非地方选举中势必遭遇惨败，纳尔逊·曼德拉(Nelson Mandela)领导的一度占主导地位的政党在全国选票已计入超过80%的情况下，其得票率跌至三分之一以下。
周三零散的投票标志着非国大衰落的又一个阶段。自1994年白人少数种族隔离统治结束以来，非国大一直领导着各国政府。高失业率、犯罪、腐败和糟糕的当地服务交付都导致选民远离该党。
随着各党派开始闭门进行联合谈判，前解放运动预计将失去豪登省和夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省这两个人口最多省份最大政党的地位。最终结果预计将于周日公布。
非国大在全国的选票率为 31.8%，比 2021 年地方选举的结果低近 14 个百分点。白人领导的中右翼民主联盟 (DA) 获得 24.1% 的选票，而前非国大主席雅各布·祖马 (Jacob Zuma) 领导的 uMkhonto weSizwe (MK) 政党则获得 9.3% 的选票。
周三的民意调查的投票率也有所上升。选举委员会估计，54.5% 的登记选民参加了投票，高于五年前的 46%。
该国一些最大城市的联盟的最终形态仍不清楚，最终选票仍在统计中。主要政党的高级人士表示，他们几乎会与任何人交谈，同时对谈判策略保密。
在拥有 480 万人口的南非商业首都和最大城市约翰内斯堡，选民不得不面对经常断水断电、垃圾无人收集和坑坑洼洼的问题。在过去十年中，由于联盟不稳定，该市已经更换了 10 次市长，并承认有 2200 亿兰特（99 亿英镑）的基础设施支出积压。

约翰内斯堡的选票已清点一半多一点，地方检察官在 75 岁的开普敦前市长海伦·齐勒 (Helen Zille) 的领导下开展了一场充满活力的竞选活动，以 40% 的得票率领先。领导当前联盟的非国大以 17.5% 的支持率位居第二。由赫尔曼·马沙巴 (Herman Mashaba) 领导的右翼政党 ActionSA 的支持率为 15.5%。马沙巴承诺永远不会与齐勒合作，他称齐勒为“种族主义者”，但她强烈否认这一点。
非国大的许多乡镇据点尚未报告完整结果。受人尊敬的智囊团科学与工业研究委员会 (CSIR) 预计 DA 将获得 34%、ANC 20% 和 ActionSA 16.8%。
豪登省三个城市的联盟经常一起谈判。 DA 在这三个方面都处于领先地位。
由 84 岁的祖马领导的 MK 党继续经受住并否认众多腐败指控，预计将取代非国大成为夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省最大政党。它成立于 2023 年，将社会保守的祖鲁民族主义与将土地和财富从南非白人重新分配给黑人的承诺结合在一起。
德班所在的 eThekwini 市已计票一半，MK 获得 41% 的选票，这意味着其他政党可以组成联盟来阻止其掌权。与此同时，尽管中产阶级对不断上涨的住房成本越来越愤怒，但预计DA仍将在开普敦保持多数席位。
选民选出一名地方议员和一个政党，席位通过比例代表制分配。然后，议员们将有两周时间选举市长并组建市政府。

title_en: Russell Brand to learn sentence after being found guilty of rape and sexual assault
title_zh: 拉塞尔·布兰德 (Russell Brand) 因强奸和性侵犯罪名成立后将接受判刑
summary: Comedian Brand faces a "significant" prison sentence, which a London court judge is set to hand down on Monday.
summary_zh: 喜剧演员布兰德面临“重大”监禁，伦敦法院法官将于周一宣判。
body_en: Russell Brand to learn sentence after being found guilty of rape : NPR
Russell Brand to learn sentence after being found guilty of rape Comedian Brand faces a "significant" prison sentence, which a London court judge is set to hand down on Monday.
Comedian and actor Russell Brand leaves Southwark Crown Court in London, Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026. Alastair Grant/AP hide caption
Comedian Russell Brand faces a "significant" prison sentence, which a London court judge is set to hand down on Monday.

On Thursday the one-time MTV host turned Christian and spiritual influencer was found guilty on three counts of sexual assault and one of rape, after a four-week trial that garnered massive media attention.
Brand had denied all charges and said he never had sex without consent.
From comedian to convicted rapist: What to know about Russell Brand
After the jury handed down the verdict, Judge Joel Bennathan told Brand, 51, that he faced a "significant custodial term."

Danny Shaw, a crime commentator and former BBC correspondent, posted on X that while the maximum sentence for rape in the UK is life, 10 years is the average sentence, and Brand was likely to receive between four to 13 years of prison time.

The trial examined seven historic charges against Brand, brought forward by six different women. He was found guilty on four of the charges: for raping a woman who'd been to one of his comedy shows in 2009, and sexually assaulting three others between 2004 and 2009. The locations of the sexual assaults were a bar, radio station and TV studio. Brand was also found not guilty of two counts of rape and one count of attempted indecent assault.

Brand's lawyer asked the judge on Thursday to grant his client bail so that he could spend the weekend with his three children, which the judge denied. Instead the one-time celebrity darling spent his first weekend in a prison cell in London.
He showed little emotion when the verdict was handed down, though his wife Laura — who has supported him throughout — quickly left the courtroom.
Many have called the verdict a significant milestone in the #MeToo movement, which has seen influential men held to account for using their power to abuse women.

Brand has also faced allegations of crimes in the United States. In 2023, a woman, named only as "Jane Doe," accused Brand of sexually assaulting her while she was working as a film extra during the making of the 2010 comedy movie "Arthur." That year, Brand married pop star Katy Perry, though the union lasted for just over a year before they divorced.

Addressing the media last week, London police detective Andy Furphy said that Brand had "used his influence, status and fame to prey on women — as his profile grew, so too did his sense of entitlement."

Camilla Long, a journalist for The Sunday Times — one of the first newspapers that investigated allegations of abuse against Brand — wrote in a column this weekend that "To sit in court 3 at Southwark crown court, hearing how Brand grabbed, pushed, groped and degraded his victims, was one of the most disgusting experiences of my life."
Long questioned how Brand got away with his behavior for so long, saying: "Never has a predator so loudly declared himself, yet been so roundly ignored."

body_zh: 拉塞尔·布兰德在被判强奸罪后将接受判刑：NPR
喜剧演员拉塞尔·布兰德 (Russell Brand) 因强奸罪被判有罪，将接受量刑 喜剧演员布兰德 (Russell Brand) 面临“重大”监禁，伦敦法院法官将于周一宣判。
喜剧演员兼演员拉塞尔·布兰德于 2026 年 11 月 3 日星期二离开伦敦南华克刑事法院。阿拉斯泰尔·格兰特/美联社隐藏标题栏
喜剧演员拉塞尔·布兰德面临“重大”监禁，伦敦法院法官将于周一宣判。
周四，经过为期四个星期的审判，这位曾经的 MTV 主持人转型为基督徒和精神影响者，被判犯有三项性侵犯罪和一项强奸罪，引起了媒体的广泛关注。
布兰德否认了所有指控，并表示他从未在未经同意的情况下发生性行为。
从喜剧演员到被定罪的强奸犯：关于拉塞尔·布兰德的了解
陪审团作出裁决后，法官乔尔·本纳森 (Joel Bennathan) 告诉 51 岁的布兰德，他面临“长期监禁”。
犯罪评论员、前 BBC 记者丹尼·肖 (Danny Shaw) 在 X 上发帖称，虽然英国强奸罪的最高刑期为无期徒刑，但平均刑期为 10 年，布兰德可能会被判 4 至 13 年监禁。
审判审查了六名不同女性对布兰德提出的七项历史性指控。他被判犯有四项罪名：强奸一名曾在 2009 年观看他的喜剧节目的妇女，以及在 2004 年至 2009 年间对另外三人进行性侵犯。性侵犯的地点是一家酒吧、广播电台和电视演播室。布兰德还被判犯有两项强奸罪和一项未遂猥亵罪。
布兰德的律师周四请求法官准予他的当事人保释，以便他可以与三个孩子共度周末，但法官拒绝了这一请求。相反，这位曾经的名人宠儿在伦敦的牢房里度过了他的第一个周末。
判决下达后，他几乎没有表现出任何情绪，但一直支持他的妻子劳拉很快就离开了法庭。
许多人称这一判决是#MeToo运动中的一个重要里程碑，在该运动中，有影响力的男性因利用权力虐待女性而被追究责任。
布兰德在美国也面临犯罪指控。 2023 年，一名名叫“Jane Doe”的女性指控布兰德在她 2010 年喜剧电影《亚瑟》制作期间担任临时演员时对她进行了性侵犯。那一年，布兰德与流行歌星凯蒂·佩里结婚，尽管这段婚姻只维持了一年多就离婚了。
伦敦警探安迪·弗菲上周向媒体发表讲话时表示，布兰德“利用他的影响力、地位和名气来掠夺女性——随着他的知名度不断提高，他的权利意识也随之增强。”
《星期日泰晤士报》的记者卡米拉·朗（Camilla Long）是最早调查布兰德虐待指控的报纸之一，她在本周末的一篇专栏文章中写道，“坐在南华克皇家法院第三法庭，听到布兰德如何抓住、推搡、摸索和侮辱他的受害者，是我一生中最恶心的经历之一。”
朗质疑布兰德为何能在这么长的时间里逍遥法外，他说：“从来没有一个掠夺者如此大声地宣称自己，但却被如此彻底地忽视。”

title_en: Homes and temples glow across India to mark Diwali
title_zh: 印度各地的房屋和寺庙点亮灯光以纪念排灯节
summary: Millions of Indians are marking the festival of lights with glowing lamps, fireworks and traditional sweets.
summary_zh: 数百万印度人用发光的灯、烟花和传统糖果来庆祝排灯节。
body_en: Millions across India are celebrating Diwali, the Hindu festival of lights, illuminating homes, temples, offices and streets with oil lamps and colourful lights to symbolise the triumph of light over darkness.
The festival falls on the darkest night of the Hindu lunar month of Kartik, when the moon is not visible in the sky.
Although Diwali traditions vary across India's regions and communities, the festival is widely marked by prayers, family gatherings, the exchange of sweets and the lighting of firecrackers.
But the celebrations come amid growing concerns over air pollution , particularly in northern India.
Seasonal weather conditions and the burning of crop residue contribute to deteriorating air quality, while firecrackers set off during Diwali can make the situation worse.

Air pollution in the Indian capital Delhi has reached such hazardous levels that it is the most polluted Diwali festival in a decade. New measures to improve air quality do not seem to have been successful.
India's financial capital, Mumbai, has also experienced high pollution levels in recent weeks.
In an effort to limit pollution, India's Supreme Court on Monday permitted the manufacture, sale and use of certified "green" firecrackers in Delhi and surrounding areas for a limited period.

These firecrackers are designed to produce 20-30% fewer emissions than conventional fireworks. But critics have questioned how effective they are at reducing pollution and raised concerns that conventional firecrackers could still make their way into the capital from neighbouring states.
Despite the debate over fireworks, Diwali is about much more than firecrackers.

The festival celebrates the return of Lord Ram to Ayodhya after his victory over Ravan, the main antagonist in the Hindu epic Ramayana, and symbolises the triumph of good over evil, light over darkness, and knowledge over ignorance.
In the days leading up to the festival, families clean and decorate their homes with flowers, colourful lights and traditional oil lamps known as diyas.
The celebrations also bring families and friends together for prayers, elaborate feasts and the exchange of gifts, and lots of traditional Indian sweets.
Colourful patterns known as rangoli are created at entrances to homes, while markets bustle with shoppers buying festive essentials beneath brightly lit decorations.
The celebrations began on 6 November with Dhanteras, when buying gold, silver or new utensils is considered auspicious and believed to bring good fortune.
The second day, known as Chhoti Diwali, or small Diwali, is marked by the lighting of oil lamps and, in some households, setting off firecrackers.
The third day is the main celebration, when families offer evening prayers to Lakshmi, the Hindu goddess of wealth and prosperity, before gathering for festive meals and fireworks.

The fourth day is celebrated differently across India, with family gatherings and New Year festivities in some communities. The fifth and final day, known as Bhai Dooj, celebrates the bond between brothers and sisters.
The festival is also celebrated by Sikhs and Jains along with other important religious observances.
Sikhs mark Bandi Chhor Divas, or Prisoner Release Day, commemorating the release of their sixth guru, Guru Hargobind, from imprisonment at Gwalior Fort in the early 17th Century.
body_zh: 印度各地数百万人正在庆祝印度教排灯节，用油灯和彩色灯光照亮房屋、寺庙、办公室和街道，象征光明战胜黑暗。
这个节日发生在印度农历卡尔提克月最黑暗的夜晚，此时天空中看不到月亮。
尽管印度各个地区和社区的排灯节传统各不相同，但这个节日的广泛特征是祈祷、家庭聚会、交换糖果和燃放鞭炮。
但庆祝活动是在人们对空气污染日益担忧的背景下举行的，特别是在印度北部。
季节性天气条件和燃烧农作物残茬会导致空气质量恶化，而排灯节期间燃放的鞭炮会使情况变得更糟。
印度首都德里的空气污染已达到危险水平，成为十年来污染最严重的排灯节。改善空气质量的新措施似乎并不成功。
印度金融首都孟买最近几周也经历了严重污染。
为了限制污染，印度最高法院周一允许在德里及周边地区在有限时间内制造、销售和使用经过认证的“绿色”鞭炮。
这些鞭炮的排放量比传统烟花少 20-30%。但批评人士质疑它们在减少污染方面的效果如何，并担心传统鞭炮仍可能从邻国进入首都。
尽管关于烟花的争论颇多，但排灯节的意义远不止于鞭炮。
这个节日庆祝罗摩勋爵战胜印度史诗《罗摩衍那》中的主要对手拉万后返回阿约提亚，象征着正义战胜邪恶、光明战胜黑暗、知识战胜无知。
在节日前几天，各家各户都会用鲜花、彩灯和被称为“迪亚”的传统油灯来打扫和装饰自己的房屋。
庆祝活动还将家人和朋友聚集在一起进行祈祷、精心准备的盛宴、交换礼物以及许多传统的印度糖果。
各家各户的入口处都饰有被称为“兰戈里”的彩色图案，市场里熙熙攘攘，购物者在灯火通明的装饰下购买节日必需品。
庆祝活动从 11 月 6 日的 Dhanteras 开始，届时购买黄金、白银或新器皿被认为是吉祥的，并相信会带来好运。
第二天被称为“Chhoti Diwali”或“小排灯节”，人们会点起油灯，有些家庭还会燃放鞭炮。
第三天是主要的庆祝活动，家人会向印度教财富和繁荣女神拉克希米进行晚间祈祷，然后聚集在一起享用节日大餐和烟花。
印度各地庆祝第四天的方式各不相同，一些社区举行家庭聚会和新年庆祝活动。第五天也是最后一天，被称为 Bhai Dooj，庆祝兄弟姐妹之间的联系。
锡克教徒和耆那教徒也庆祝这个节日以及其他重要的宗教仪式。
锡克教徒会庆祝 Bandi Chhor Divas，即囚犯释放日，纪念他们的第六位古鲁古鲁哈戈宾德 (Guru Hargobind) 在 17 世纪初从瓜廖尔堡的监禁中获释。

title_en: US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme
title_zh: 美国悬赏2000万美元征集有关伊朗核计划的信息
summary: Donald Trump has repeatedly raised the prospect of renewing strikes against Iran's nuclear facilities.
summary_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普多次提出重新打击伊朗核设施的可能性。
body_en: The US has announced a reward of up to $20 million for information about Iran's nuclear programme.
The State Department's Rewards for Justice is also offering to potentially relocate the person who provides such details.
President Donald Trump claimed last year that Iran's nuclear facilities had been "completely and totally obliterated " following a bombing campaign by the US and Israel.
Iran insists its nuclear programme is peaceful and that it has no intention of developing a nuclear weapon.
Meanwhile, the US military says it is setting up a task force to enhance Washington's efforts to restrict Iran's movement of weapons and sanctioned material across its borders.
The US military's Central Command (Centcom) said Task Force Iron Gate would operate from Tampa, Florida, and would work with other US government agencies.
As well as the movement of weapons, it will also focus on dual-use and illegal revenue streams.
Centcom estimates that its naval blockade of Iran's ports has prevented the country from exporting more than $25bn in crude oil.
Major construction ongoing near Iran missile bases, satellite images suggest

A US State Department statement about its multi-million dollar reward said it was offering the money for information about the Iranian programme, including "facilities, equipment and associated personnel".

It said Iran's "lack of compliance with the IAEA [the International Atomic Energy Agency] on safeguards obligations has led to the agency's loss of 'continuity of knowledge' regarding Iran's production and inventory of key components like [nuclear] centrifuges".
Centrifuges are needed to produce enriched uranium, which can be used to make reactor fuel for civilian use but also for nuclear weapons if enriched to around 90% purity or higher.

There had been mounting speculation that the US might resume significant strikes in Iran after the midterm elections, though Trump told reporters, prior to the polls, that he was in "no rush" to do so.
In an interview with Fox News on the eve of the midterms, the president also said the US "might need to go after Pickaxe [Mountain]", an underground site linked to Iran's nuclear programme.
This was "not a big deal" and could be done in "one hour", Trump said.
The president has repeatedly threatened to bomb the suspected underground site on previous occasions.

However, both Trump and Vice-President JD Vance have said public opposition to the war on Iran fuelled heavy losses for their Republican Party in this week's midterm elections, which has led to speculation the White House may no longer seek an escalation in the conflict.
On Friday, Trump insisted that Iran was keen to end the eight-month conflict with the US, stressing the damage to Tehran's economy and military.
"We're dealing with them now. They want to make a deal very badly," he said.
Qatar's foreign ministry spokesman said on Tuesday that both sides were "reviewing the ideas and proposals we have presented" and that it remained hopeful of a deal being agreed.
body_zh: 美国宣布悬赏高达 2000 万美元，征集有关伊朗核计划的信息。
国务院正义奖励计划还提出可能重新安置提供此类详细信息的人。
唐纳德·特朗普总统去年声称，在美国和以色列的轰炸行动之后，伊朗的核设施已被“彻底摧毁”。
伊朗坚称其核计划是和平目的，无意发展核武器。
与此同时，美国军方表示正在成立一个特别工作组，以加强华盛顿限制伊朗武器和受制裁材料跨境流动的努力。
美国军方中央司令部（Centcom）表示，铁门特遣部队将从佛罗里达州坦帕市开展行动，并将与其他美国政府机构合作。
除了武器的流动外，它还将重点关注军民两用和非法收入来源。
Centcom 估计，其对伊朗港口的海上封锁导致该国无法出口超过 250 亿美元的原油。
卫星图像显示，伊朗导弹基地附近正在进行重大建设
美国国务院关于其数百万美元奖励的声明称，它提供资金以获取有关伊朗计划的信息，包括“设施、设备和相关人员”。
报告称，伊朗“不遵守国际原子能机构的保障义务，导致该机构失去了有关伊朗生产和库存等关键部件（如核）离心机的‘连续性知识’”。
生产浓缩铀需要离心机，浓缩铀可用于制造民用反应堆燃料，如果浓缩至 90% 左右或更高，还可用于制造核武器。
人们越来越多地猜测美国可能会在中期选举后恢复对伊朗的大规模打击，尽管特朗普在民意调查前告诉记者，他“不急于”这样做。
在中期选举前夕接受福克斯新闻采访时，总统还表示，美国“可能需要追查镐[山]”，这是一个与伊朗核计划有关的地下场所。
特朗普表示，这“没什么大不了的”，可以在“一小时内”完成。
总统此前曾多次威胁要轰炸这个可疑的地下场所。
然而，特朗普和副总统万斯均表示，公众对伊朗战争的反对导致共和党在本周的中期选举中遭受惨重损失，这引发人们猜测白宫可能不再寻求冲突升级。
周五，特朗普坚称伊朗渴望结束与美国长达八个月的冲突，并强调这对德黑兰经济和军事造成的损害。
“我们现在正在与他们打交道。他们非常想达成协议，”他说。
卡塔尔外交部发言人周二表示，双方正在“审查我们提出的想法和建议”，并且仍然对达成协议抱有希望。

title_en: How African philosophies inspired a new approach to staging film festivals in Manchester
title_zh: 非洲哲学如何启发在曼彻斯特举办电影节的新方法
summary: See My World, an event highlighting the pan-African thought via film, poetry and dance, builds on momentum sparked by local activists and creatives African philosophies including exploring how lessons from the past can shape the present and near future have in
summary_zh: See My World 是一项通过电影、诗歌和舞蹈突出泛非思想的活动，以当地活动家和创意人士激发的势头为基础
body_en: How African philosophies inspired a new approach to staging film festivals in Manchester | Manchester
See My World, an event highlighting the pan-African thought via film, poetry and dance, builds on momentum sparked by local activists and creatives
African philosophies including exploring how lessons from the past can shape the present and near future have inspired a film festival coming to Manchester .
See My World , a day dedicated to independent creators from across the African diaspora in the north of England, will take place at the Contact theatre on 21 November.
The festival is part of See My World’s year-round programme showcasing pan-African arts, culture and events.

It reflects the determination among creatives and activists in Manchester to build on the legacy of the 1945 Pan-African Congress in Manchester – which connected luminaries of postwar independence movements with a shared vision of liberation – after last year’s 80th anniversary commemorations .

See My World’s CEO and artistic director, Tunde Adekoya, said this month’s film festival was taking inspiration from across the spectrum of pan-African thought, including the works of Kenyan writers John Mbiti, an Anglican theologian who died in 2019, and Ngũgĩ wa Thiong’o, the author of the groundbreaking 1986 book Decolonising the Mind who died last year.

Both writers rejected the colonial conceit that African thought was inferior, stressed the importance of community and saw reclaiming African ways of knowing as essential to a people’s self-understanding.

While Mbiti sought common ground between African religions and Christianity, Ngũgĩ was a Marxist. He argued colonialism was motivated by cultural and economic conquest, and that European powers used language as their sharpest instrument. Ngũgĩ famously abandoned English to write in Gikuyu, a Bantu language mainly spoken in Kenya and criticised the role missionary Christianity played in colonial rule.

Adekoya said: “It’s a day dedicated to pan-African and global majority films from the north of England with exclusive premieres of documentaries we’ve been working on, which weave together expressions of liberation through art forms like poetry and dance.
‘A sense of freedom’: 80 years on from the Pan-African Congress in Manchester
“The whole idea is that it’s like a playground in search of strategies of liberation, using the festival as a way to explore different philosophies.

“John Mbiti explores the philosophy and spiritual understandings of time through the concept of Sasa na Zamani – in which the past informs everything that happens moving forward. That reflects how we constantly go back to pan-African histories to inform how we progress.”
Film-makers have been invited to submit films lasting up to 30 minutes from across genres, with no screening fees charged.

As well as submissions, the festival will feature documentaries produced by See My World. They include Homage, a “cinematic love letter to dance” that traces a culture through present-day portraits illustrating dance artists and archival material from Manchester, telling a story of joy, loss, migration, rhythm and resistance. Meanwhile, Poetic Justice explores how pan-African thought and Manchester’s poetry scene speak across decades.

Adekoya added: “The idea is that we would go against the norm of how film festivals are, because when we think about decolonisation, we think about how structures have been created to alienate and exclude communities.

“So we thought our film festival would look more at how we make film accessible and how stories that deserve to be seen get seen. Throughout the day we will have different activities, from exhibitions to explorations of our performances, discussions, Q&As, insights into directors’ processes, and workshops.

“We’ve been looking for literature and concepts that inform us and give us an understanding of who we truly are. And as works from thinkers like John Mbiti have come into our sphere, they have really emboldened us to think differently about our place in the world and what we do.”
See My World film festival runs from 2pm to 11pm on Saturday 21 November at Contact theatre, Oxford Road, Manchester.
body_zh: 非洲哲学如何启发在曼彻斯特举办电影节的新方法 |曼彻斯特
See My World 是一项通过电影、诗歌和舞蹈突出泛非思想的活动，以当地活动家和创意人士激发的势头为基础
非洲哲学，包括探索过去的教训如何塑造现在和不久的将来，激发了曼彻斯特电影节的灵感。
See My World 活动将于 11 月 21 日在 Contact 剧院举行，该活动旨在纪念英格兰北部非洲侨民的独立创作者。
该节日是“看到我的世界”全年计划的一部分，展示泛非艺术、文化和活动。
它反映了曼彻斯特的创意人士和活动人士在去年的 80 周年纪念活动之后决心继承 1945 年曼彻斯特泛非大会的遗产，该大会将战后独立运动的杰出人物与共同的解放愿景联系在一起。
See My World 首席执行官兼艺术总监 Tunde Adekoya 表示，本月的电影节从泛非思想的各个领域汲取灵感，其中包括 2019 年去世的英国圣公会神学家肯尼亚作家约翰·姆比蒂 (John Mbiti) 的作品，以及去年去世的 1986 年开创性著作《去殖民化心灵》的作者 Ngũgĩ wa Thiong’o 的作品。
两位作家都拒绝认为非洲思想低劣的殖民观念，强调社区的重要性，并认为恢复非洲的认知方式对于人民的自我理解至关重要。
姆比蒂寻求非洲宗教和基督教之间的共同点，而恩格吉则是马克思主义者。他认为殖民主义的动机是文化和经济征服，欧洲列强将语言作为他们最锋利的工具。恩格吉 (Ngũgĩ) 放弃英语，改用基库尤语（一种主要在肯尼亚使用的班图语）写作，并批评了传教士基督教在殖民统治中所扮演的角色。
阿德科亚说：“这一天专门展示来自英格兰北部的泛非和全球大多数电影，并独家首映了我们一直在制作的纪录片，这些纪录片通过诗歌和舞蹈等艺术形式将解放的表达交织在一起。
“自由感”：曼彻斯特泛非大会 80 周年
“整个想法是，它就像一个寻找解放策略的游乐场，利用节日作为探索不同哲学的方式。
“约翰·姆比蒂通过 Sasa na Zamani 的概念探索了对时间的哲学和精神理解——其中过去告诉了未来发生的一切。这反映了我们如何不断地回顾泛非历史来告知我们如何进步。”
电影制作人受邀提交时长不超过 30 分钟的各种类型的电影，且不收取放映费。
除了提交作品外，电影节还将放映由 See My World 制作的纪录片。其中包括《Homage》，这是一封“给舞蹈的电影情书”，通过描绘舞蹈艺术家的当今肖像和曼彻斯特的档案材料来追溯一种文化，讲述一个关于欢乐、失落、迁徙、节奏和抵抗的故事。与此同时，《诗意正义》探讨了泛非思想和曼彻斯特的诗歌场景在过去几十年中如何对话。
阿德科亚补充道：“我们的想法是，我们将违背电影节的常态，因为当我们考虑非殖民化时，我们会想到如何创建疏远和排斥社区的结构。
“所以我们认为我们的电影节应该更多地关注如何让电影变得触手可及，以及如何让值得被观看的故事被人看到。一整天我们都会举办不同的活动，从展览到表演探索、讨论、问答、对导演流程的洞察和研讨会。
“我们一直在寻找能够告诉我们并让我们了解自己真实身份的文献和概念。随着像约翰·姆比蒂这样的思想家的作品进入我们的领域，它们确实鼓励我们以不同的方式思考我们在世界上的地位和我们所做的事情。”
See My World 电影节于 11 月 21 日星期六下午 2 点至晚上 11 点在曼彻斯特牛津路的 Contact 剧院举行。

Fermin Lopez scored twice as Barcelona overcame an early deficit at Atletico Madrid to win 2-1 and go three points clear at the top of La Liga.
Barca’s win takes them three points clear of second-placed Real Madrid and five ahead of Atletico, in third, after 12 games.

Giuliano Simeone opened the scoring in the 10th minute for the home side, turning home a close range volley from Julian Alvarez’s cross from the left.
The home side had a series of early chances as they sought to register an eighth straight win, but Fermin swept in an equaliser on the cusp of halftime after a ball broke to him in the box.

Lamine Yamal set up Fermin’s second goal in the 66th minute with an incisive pass, and Lopez fired past Jan Oblak with a first-time finish to silence the Metropolitano and secure a fifth straight away league win over Atleti for the first time.
“It was a very difficult match. The first half was tough, but we managed to come from behind and secure the win,” Barcelona midfielder Lopez told La Liga TV after the match.
“I think we were not being clinical enough. After the goal, we gained more confidence.
“Lamine [Yamal] has been very good. His pass for the second goal was half the goal itself. I’m very happy,” Lopez said.
“We wanted to go into the break as league leaders and get three points. The equaliser lifted a weight off our shoulders, and we had more control.
“We knew at halftime that we had to continue playing the way we finished the first half. I think the team produced an incredible second half, both defensively and offensively. We’re very happy.”

title_en: President Milei welcomes Pope Leo during historic visit to Argentina
title_zh: 米莱总统欢迎教皇利奥对阿根廷进行历史性访问
summary: Pope Leo XIV's visit marks the first papal trip to Argentina in nearly four decades, amid tensions with the government.
summary_zh: 教皇利奥十四世的访问标志着近四十年来教皇首次访问阿根廷，当时与政府关系紧张。
body_en: Share President Milei welcomes Pope Leo during historic visit to Argentina on social media
Argentinian President Javier Milei has welcomed the head of the Catholic Church, Pope Leo XIV, upon his arrival at Jorge Newbery airport near Buenos Aires.
Milei and his sister, presidential secretary Karina Milei, greeted the pope on Sunday amid tensions between the government and Argentina’s Catholic Church over austerity measures.

Prior to his arrival, the pope spent three days in Uruguay , the first stop on his tour of Latin America.
He is the first pontiff to visit Argentina in nearly four decades, since John Paul II’s trip in 1987.

“Without a doubt, it gives us great joy that this pope is visiting us,” said Jorge Silanes, religious director at the Pequeno Cottolengo Don Orione, a home for people with disabilities in the Buenos Aires province.
In Argentina, Pope Leo’s schedule includes attending a welcome ceremony at Plaza San Martin and a meeting with Milei at the Casa Rosada, the official presidential palace.
But the pontiff’s visit comes amid shrinking membership in the Catholic Church in Latin America, as well as a sometimes fractious relationship with politicians like Milei.
Catholics comprise the largest religious group in Latin America, with as many as 425 million people identifying with the church.

But their numbers have shrunk over the last decade. A Pew Research Center survey found that, in Argentina, the percentage of self-identifying Catholics slipped from 71 percent in the 2013-2014 year to 58 percent a decade later.
Milei himself has suggested he considered converting to Judaism, though he was raised in the Catholic faith.
The Catholic Church has also criticised Milei’s austerity measures, which included slashing social spending and safety-net programmes for the poor.
Milei has defended the budget cuts as necessary to bring inflation under control.
Some members of the Catholic clergy, however, have taken a visible role in the protests against Milei’s measures.
Leo, 71, the first US-born pope, will remain in Argentina until Wednesday and meet with officials, diplomats and civil society representatives.
He will also visit a prison and celebrate mass in Buenos Aires, Lujan, and the province of Cordoba, before travelling to Peru, where he spent years serving as a bishop.
The previous pope, Francis, was born in Buenos Aires in 1936 and was the first pope from the Americas, but he never visited his home country as head of the Catholic Church. Francis died in 2025.

抵达之前，教皇在乌拉圭度过了三天，这是他拉丁美洲之行的第一站。
他是自约翰·保罗二世 1987 年访问阿根廷以来，近四十年来首位访问阿根廷的教皇。
布宜诺斯艾利斯省残疾人之家 Pequeno Cottolengo Don Orione 的宗教主任豪尔赫·西拉内斯 (Jorge Silanes) 表示：“毫无疑问，教皇来拜访我们让我们感到非常高兴。”
在阿根廷，教皇利奥的日程包括参加在圣马丁广场举行的欢迎仪式，以及在官方总统府玫瑰宫与米莱会面。
但教宗此次访问正值拉丁美洲天主教会成员不断减少，以及与米莱等政客的关系时而紧张之际。
天主教徒是拉丁美洲最大的宗教团体，有多达 4.25 亿人认同该教会。
但在过去十年中，他们的数量有所减少。皮尤研究中心的一项调查发现，在阿根廷，自我认同为天主教徒的比例从 2013-2014 年的 71% 下降到十年后的 58%。
米莱本人曾建议他考虑皈依犹太教，尽管他是在天主教信仰中长大的。
天主教会还批评了米莱的紧缩措施，其中包括削减社会支出和针对穷人的安全网计划。
米莱辩称，削减预算是控制通胀所必需的。
然而，一些天主教神职人员在反对米莱措施的抗议活动中扮演了明显的角色。
71岁的利奥是第一位在美国出生的教皇，他将在阿根廷停留至周三，并会见官员、外交官和民间社会代表。
他还将参观布宜诺斯艾利斯、卢汉和科尔多瓦省的一所监狱并庆祝弥撒，然后前往秘鲁，他在那里担任主教多年。
前任教皇方济各1936年出生于布宜诺斯艾利斯，是第一位来自美洲的教皇，但他从未以天主教会领袖的身份访问过自己的祖国。弗朗西斯于 2025 年去世。

title_en: US chipmaker Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang over affair

summary: Huang has confirmed he had been having an affair with a woman accused of spying for China.

body_en: Share US chipmaker Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang over affair on social media

United States-based chipmaker Nvidia is investigating its chief executive officer, billionaire Jensen Huang, after he confirmed he had an intimate relationship with a woman accused of working for Chinese intelligence.
In an announcement on Sunday, Nvidia said the probe would be conducted by a “committee of independent directors” with outside counsel.

“While the board has no reason to believe that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, the board’s inquiry will examine all available information,” Nvidia’s board of directors said.
It said the board continued to have “confidence in Jensen and his leadership team”. Huang will continue to lead Nvidia during the probe.
The investigation follows a report in The New York Times last month that Jensen may have been the target of a Chinese espionage plot.
China and the US have been in competition to dominate key tech sectors like artificial intelligence (AI).
Amid the AI boom, Nvidia has seen demand for its chips and programming interfaces explode, resulting in the company being valued in the trillions of dollars.
For years, the US has sought to restrict the export of advanced chips to China, fearing the Asian superpower could gain an edge over its technology and military sectors.

But on October 29, The New York Times said it had obtained exclusive information that a Chinese woman named Alice Huang, or Huang Le, sought to cultivate close ties with Jensen Huang in an effort to glean information about Nvidia’s technology.
The Chinese Embassy in Washington, DC, has denied any allegations of spying in the case.
The New York Times also reported that Alice Huang’s employer, Megaspeed, had become one of Nvidia’s largest buyers, purchasing some $4.8bn in equipment from the US firm.
Jensen Huang’s ties to Alice Huang, who is of no relation, spurred fierce bipartisan backlash in the US Congress in the aftermath of the report.
“For months, bipartisan members of Congress have raised concerns about NVIDIA’s advanced AI chips going to China,” Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren wrote in a statement.
“NVIDIA’s Jensen Huang and NVIDIA’s board owe Congress answers. And we need to pass bipartisan legislation we have ready to stop advanced American technology from going to China.”
Republican lawmakers in the House of Representatives also called on Huang to appear and testify before Congress about the affair on November 18.
“It is vital that Congress determines the extent to which US national security has been placed at risk,” Republicans John Moolenaar, Brian Mast and Rick Crawford said in a statement.

英伟达在周日的一份声明中表示，调查将由一个“独立董事委员会”和外部顾问进行。

英伟达董事会表示：“虽然董事会没有理由相信国家安全或英伟达机密遭到泄露，但董事会的调查将检查所有可用信息。”
声明称，董事会仍然“对詹森及其领导团队充满信心”。在调查期间，黄仁勋将继续领导英伟达。
此次调查是在《纽约时报》上个月报道称詹森可能是中国间谍阴谋的目标之后进行的。
中国和美国一直在争夺人工智能（AI）等关键技术领域的主导地位。
在人工智能热潮中，英伟达的芯片和编程接口需求激增，导致该公司估值数万亿美元。
多年来，美国一直试图限制向中国出口先进芯片，担心这个亚洲超级大国可能在其技术和军事领域获得优势。
但 10 月 29 日，《纽约时报》称其获得独家消息称，一位名叫 Alice Huang 或黄乐的中国女性试图与黄仁勋建立密切关系，以收集有关 Nvidia 技术的信息。
中国驻华盛顿大使馆否认了此案中的任何间谍指控。
《纽约时报》还报道称，Alice Huang 的雇主 Megaspeed 已成为 Nvidia 最大的买家之一，从这家美国公司购买了约 48 亿美元的设备。
该报告发布后，黄仁勋与没有任何关系的黄爱丽丝的关系引发了美国国会两党的强烈反对。
民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 在一份声明中写道：“几个月来，国会两党议员一直对 NVIDIA 的先进人工智能芯片进入中国表示担忧。”
“NVIDIA 的黄仁勋和 NVIDIA 董事会欠国会一个答案。我们需要通过两党立法，我们已经准备好阻止美国先进技术流入中国。”
众议院共和党议员也呼吁黄于11月18日就此事出庭作证。
共和党人约翰·莫勒纳尔、布莱恩·马斯特和里克·克劳福德在一份声明中表示：“国会确定美国国家安全面临风险的程度至关重要。”
